name: awa-workflows
description: Validate, view and simulate Agentic Workflow Architecture (AWA) workflows and customer journeys. Simulation only: no tool, model or production system is called.
long_description: Work with documents of the open standard Agentic Workflow Architecture (AWA). Validate a workflow or journey and read its problems in plain words. See a workflow as a graph with its actors, decisions, events and the data that moves between activities. Simulate a run and replay it step by step. Play business events through customer journeys. Open a dashboard of measures. A fictional insurance example is included. Everything runs on your computer and is a simulation: no tool binding, command, HTTP call, model or production system is ever called. Documents are passed inline in the conversation; nothing is stored between calls.

tools.name: validate_document
tools.description: Check a workflow or journey document and return each problem in plain words

tools.name: show_workflow
tools.description: Show a workflow as a graph with its actors, decisions, events and the data that moves

tools.name: simulate_workflow
tools.description: Run a workflow once in simulation and replay its path, decisions, waits and failures

tools.name: show_journeys
tools.description: Show customer journeys from a portfolio, or from journeys and workflows with events to play

tools.name: simulate_journey
tools.description: Play business events through customer journeys in simulation

tools.name: load_claims_example
tools.description: Open the bundled fictional claims example and hand out its documents

tools.name: show_dashboard
tools.description: The measures of journeys and workflows: who is stuck, who is to act, outcomes, rework, waiting, cost
